title: Hospital Beds by State and Hospital Type
description: Number of public sector hospital beds at national, state, and district level, with a breakdown by hospital type.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: district
fields.title: District
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 160 administrative districts, or 'All Districts' for state-level data

fields.name: type
fields.title: Hospital Type
fields.description: [Categorical] Either an MoH-administered hospital ('hospital_moh'), MoH-administered special medical institution ('special_medical_institution'), or non-MoH hospital ('hospital_non_moh'). Special medical institutions refer to institutions with a specific focus, such as on cancer, heart disease, etc. Non-MoH hospitals refer to government hospitals under the purview of other agencies, such as army hospitals.

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from the operational hospital-level records maintained by the Health Informatics Centre (PIK) of the Ministry of Health. The data reflects the number of active hospital beds as at 31 December each year.
